name: Dencare (Chongqing) Oral Care Co., Ltd.
summary: Dencare (Chongqing) Oral Care Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale oral care products in China. The company offers oral cleaning and care products, such as toothpaste, toothbrush, and mouthwash; smart oral care products, such as electric toothbrushes and water flossers; oral disinfection products, including oral antibacterial pastes and oral antibacterial care solutions; and oral medical devices comprising tooth desensitizers. It provides its products under the Dengkang, Leng Suanling, Yiyan, Bellele, and Mengya brands. The company was founded in 1939 and is headquartered in Chongqing, China.
